name: displayProductImage
description: Display a specific car's images with auto-sliding gallery showing different views of ONE car. Images auto-advance every 2.5 seconds. Agent must provide the exact car folder name from the available cars list.

parameters.description: Exact car folder name (must match exactly). Available cars: 'Jeep_Avenger_Elektro_Longitude_Navi_Technology_und_S_image', 'Kia_Stonic_Spirit_1.0_T-GDI_EU6d-T_Automatic_image', 'Mercedes-Benz_A_250_e_PROGRESSIVE_DISTRONIC_MEMORY_MULTIBEAM_image', 'Mercedes-Benz_CLA_180_PROGRESSIVE_PANORAMA_SPURASSIST_KAMERA_image', 'Mercedes-Benz_CLA_180_Shooting_Brake_EDITION_DISTRONIC_NAV_AHK_image', 'Mercedes-Benz_E_300_e_T_AVANTGARDE_DISTRONIC_KEYLESS_KAMERA_image', 'Mercedes-Benz_EQA_250+_AMG_SPURPAKET_KAMERA_PDC_LENKRADHEIZ_image', 'Mercedes-Benz_G_500_FINAL_EDITION_WHITE_AMG_LEDER_STANDHZG_AHK_image', 'Opel_Corsa_F_GS_1.2_Sitz.&Lenkradh_100KW_EU6d_image', 'Porsche_Boxster_718_STYLE_EDITION_LED_CHRONO_BOSE_MEMORY_image'

Car view category: 'exterior_front' (front view), 'exterior_back' (rear view), 'interior' (cabin/dashboard), or 'all' (complete view). Use 'interior' when user asks about car interior, 'exterior_front' for general appearance, 'all' for complete showcase.
Car model display title (e.g., 'Mercedes-Benz A 250e', 'Jeep Avenger Interior', 'Porsche Boxster')
Brief description of the car and the specific view/features being highlighted
